question: As of 14 October 2021, which Indian footballer was in the news for breaking Pele's 77 international goals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunil Chhetri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sunil Chhetri is a professional Indian footballer who plays as a forward and is the captain of both the Indian Super League side Bengaluru FC and the Indian national team.
 
• As of 14 October 2021, he surpassed the legendary Brazilian footballer Pele's record of 77 international goals.
 
• Chhetri is among the top international goal scorers in the world, often compared with football legends such as Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo.
 
• He has been a pivotal figure in Indian football, leading the national team to several significant victories and is regarded as one of the greatest Indian footballers of all time.

• **International Goals**

 
 
• International goals are goals scored by a player in matches between national teams, recognized by the sport's governing bodies.
 
• Sunil Chhetri's record-breaking feat places him among the elite footballers who have scored the most goals in international matches.
 
 
 
• **Pele**
 
 
• Edson Arantes do Nascimento, known as Pele, is a retired Brazilian footballer widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time.
 
• Pele scored 77 goals in 92 appearances for Brazil, holding the record for the most goals scored for the Brazilian national team for many years.
 
 
 
• **Indian Football**
 
 
• Indian football has a rich history, with the national team known for its strong performances in the mid-20th century.
 
• In recent times, players like Sunil Chhetri have brought significant attention to the sport in India, inspiring a new generation of footballers.
